money: PAPER. One fleet arm. Default OFF everywhere else.
defect: exit_manager.plan_exit_actions fires a full pre-TP1 SELL_ALL on a SINGLE flipped ribbon tick. exit_manager.py's own comment (line ~554, corrected 2026-08-08) states the spread/buffer rule was 'aspirational, never implemented' -- both real callers pass a bare single-tick categorical stack equality. On a 60-second heartbeat any one-minute wobble liquidates the whole position.
live_exhibit_2026_08_11: Three profitable puts killed in 11 minutes, holds of 57-60 seconds: risky-3 09:47 771P +20%, risky-3 09:52 771P +13%, risky-1 09:56 773P +7%. The 09:46 771P dumped at 0.54 printed 1.29 at 14:41 (our OWN bold-2 fill) -- holding 10 lots was +$840 vs the +$90 taken; 10.7% capture of a move identified at the correct minute.
why_forward_only_and_NOT_a_backtest: ribbon_flip has fired exactly FIVE times in the entire live ledger (3 on 08-11, 1 on 08-10, 1 on 07-07). There is no population to A/B. The 2026-08-08 flip-back buffer study already found the axis dead-frequency (13 flip reads across the full population) and was correctly declared UNDERPOWERED. A backtest here would be theatre. This ships as a mechanism repair with a forward kill clock, or not at all.

change.semantics: PRE-TP1 ribbon_flip_back must be TRUE on N CONSECUTIVE planning ticks before it sells. A False tick resets the streak to 0. None or 1 = today's exact behaviour (inertness contract).
change.scope: PRE-TP1 ONLY. The post-TP1 runner ribbon exit is UNTOUCHED -- that leg already banked TP1 and its give-back profile is different.
change.arming: risky-1 only, via params_patch.exit_patch. Every other arm keeps None.

forward_kill_criteria: K1: any single day where the delayed exit costs > $150 versus the single-tick counterfactual (computable from the ledger: the tick-1 quote vs the tick-N fill) -> REVERT immediately, do not wait for n.
K2: 10 forward ribbon_flip fires on the armed arm with cumulative net cost > $0 -> REVERT.

K3: the armed arm's exit mix shifts such that catastrophe-cap exits rise (delaying the ribbon exit must not simply route the same loss through the -50% cap) -> REVERT and report the routing change as the finding.
success_readout_NOT_a_ship_licence: N>=10 forward fires with net benefit > $0 AND no K3 routing shift buys ONE thing: permission to pre-register a multi-arm trial. It never auto-promotes.
revert_one_line: In automation/state/fleet/accounts.json, arm risky-1, delete pre_tp1_ribbon_confirm_ticks from params_patch.exit_patch. Byte-identical restore; takes effect on the next entry (shapes snapshot at register_entry).
disclosures: Confirmation DELAYS an exit that is sometimes right. The cost is real and K1 prices it.
n=5 lifetime means even the forward clock will be slow; that is the honest state of this knob, not a reason to skip the clock.
